qa_pair.question: In Project Northstar, inspect the agreements and identify the one governed by New York law. Return its document name exactly.
Compare the confidentiality agreement and services agreement. Which document uses an explicit GBP 500,000 liability cap?
Read the confidentiality agreement's duration and surviving obligations. For how many years do its confidentiality obligations survive termination?
Find the services agreement's fee and payment provisions. What is its monthly fee?
Find the services agreement's renewal provision rather than its breach clause. How many days of written notice prevent automatic renewal?
Compare the services agreement's liability and renewal provisions. What period of paid fees determines its liability cap?
Inspect Project Northstar's data processing source. What is the maximum stated personal data breach notification period?
Read the data processing source's subprocessor and deletion provisions. How much prior notice is required for a new subprocessor?
Compare processor and controller roles in the data processing addendum. Which organization is the controller?
Inspect the assignment provisions across the agreements. Which agreement permits supplier assignment to an affiliate on written notice?
